146000.description:
Shiratori, a civil servant in charge of controlling the city's crow population, was approached in the park by a handsome but suspicious-looking guy named Kuroo. As Kuroo had no address and was unemployed, Shiratori was wary of him, but somehow found himself unable to dislike him. One day, he finds out that Kuroo is actually a crow…?!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: カラス男に気をつけて！

146001.description:
In a world of Eastern fantasy, there are thousands of different species, each with their own cultivation path towards immortality. Lin Huanhuan sought a shortcut towards immortality by simultaneous cultivating on seven different paths. If she could combine their powers and purify her bloodline, she would become the youngest immortal ever. Lu Yunting was an ordinary guy transmigrated into this world. It turned out that he had a purifying body, the perfect vessel for mutual cultivation. The story began as she found Lu Yunting, and pushed him down on an icy bed...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

146002.description:
Tai Yuan transmigrated into his favorite game and gained the Charisma System, which allowed him raise his charisma by completing missions. Let's see how Tai Yuan will use this ability to charm and seduce his way to the top!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

146003.description: The story of a succubus that is not erotic at all.

title.native: まったくエロくないサキュバスの話
title.romaji: Mattaku Ero Kunai Succubus no Hanashi

146007.description: Anne, an imaginative young red-haired girl, is accidentally adopted from an orphanage by a pair of aging siblings who originally wanted a boy to help them work their farm. The happy accident changes everyone's lives for the better.

title.native: 高3で免許を取った。可愛くない後輩と夏旅するハメになった。
title.romaji: Kou 3 de Menkyo wo Totta. Kawaikunai Kouhai to Natsu Tabi Suru hame ni Natta.

146012.description:
Ayano Sasagawa is the unattainable flower of the class. When I rescued her from being propositioned, I suddenly found myself with her full attention...

"Thank you, Fujimura."

I was surprised to find that she even knew my name! After that, she became strangely fond of me and started hanging out with me all the time......! She brought me home on weekends and holidays, fishing for compliments as if she were a child, and even sleeping over. I was supposed to be enjoying my life as an introverted loner, but then I realized that her presence had already become a part of my daily life.......

"Are you coming over today?"
"Just you? So I'll have you all to myself!"
"......does that mean you think I'm special?"

He thought she was from another world, but now she is zero distance away.
This is a youth caste love comedy, where you are at the mercy of a girl who is too bold!

(Source: Fantasia Bunko, translated)
synonyms: ระยะห่างระหว่างเราใกล้กันไปมั้ย

title.native: 陽キャなカノジョは距離感がバグっている
title.romaji: Youkya na Kanojo wa Kyorikan ga Bugtteiru

146014.description:
Junka Sato is a high school girl who works as a maid for the Shijo family, a prominent clan that has produced politicians for generations. Junko meets the Shijo family's eldest son Yamato, who is rumored to be "useless," as well as the other members of the prime minister's family.

(Source: Sho-Comi, translated)

title.native: 紫城大和のファーストレディ

146016.description:
Karino, a girl who had been imprisoned, was finally allowed out into the world where magic was the norm. Karino possessed magic power, but she didn't know the proper incantations. So she enrolled in a magic academy with Touma, the boy who rescued her, in order to learn how to use her magic.

(Source: Sho-Comi, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

146017.description:
With the unexplained emergence of dungeons came a relentless onslaught of monsters that overwhelmed humanity. Even the Awakened, humans with special abilities to fight monsters, couldn’t stop the destruction of the world. In the end, only Seong-In Kim, the most powerful Awakened, was left standing. Upon his death, Seong-In wakes up twenty years in the past as an unassuming high school student named Su-Hyeon Kim. He’s not sure how or why he was brought back, but he does know this is his second chance to save the world and redeem himself as a hero.

(Source: Tapas, edited)
synonyms: การกลับมาของฮีโร่

146018.description:
Chen Luoyang transmigrated and found himself taking over the body of the most powerful person in this world, the master of the Demonic Sect known as the "Demon Lord." But he was badly hurt, and surrounded by powerful beings, so he had to pretend he to be nonchalant and healthy, even though he was panicking inside. In order to survive in this world full of powerful and vengeful enemies, Chen Luoyang will have to do his best acting job continue pretending to be the almighty Demon Lord.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

146019.description:
In one treacherous game, money-hungry players battle it out in a barren land with clear blue skies. You win money when you kill; you lose money when you get killed. When a girl accidentally gets involved, it's up to her brother to steer her through it at all. Will they ever earn enough to leave this godforsaken game?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

146020.description: It's a love comedy centered around newlyweds Linda, who just turned 18, and her husband Ricky who is a psychology professor at the university where Linda just enrolled as a student! Romantic rivalries and comedic circumstances ensue.

146021.description:
Sasayama always liked History, but how different is reading about it from actually getting to hold historical artifacts in his hands? That's what he's begun to find out when his overexcited senior Minami "convinces" him to join their Arch-Research Club. Sasayama insists that part of the reason why he goes along with this isn't because he thinks Minami is cute sometimes, but why are his sudden, frustrating dreams about him painting a completely different story?

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: 恋は地表マイナス2メートル

146022.description:
Ritsu Shiraishi is a super capable hotel concierge who helps private detective Kurose out of personal interest. One day, while investigating a politician's affair, Kurose discovers that Ritsu regularly meets the politician. Driven by jealousy and anger, Kurose tries to sleep with him, but finds that Ritsu also likes Kurose. So they are in love with each other. But is it a mere coincidence? It seems like Ritsu is keeping a lot more secrets...

(Source: Takeshobo)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Celui qui ne dit jamais non
A man who never says no

title.english: A Man Who Never Says No

146023.description:
On a snowy day, a beautiful transfer student named Anna, joined the boarding school. With Anna's captivating beauty, she became the object of everyone's envy. While Colette, who was the opposite of Anna in every way, builds a delicate love-hate relationship with her. All of a sudden, Anna leaves the school. A long time passes before Colette reunites with Anna, at the place where she starts working as a tutor for a noble family...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

146024.description:
After meeting terrible ends in her first two lives, Vivielle Andante didn't have high hopes for her third. Luckily, she's reborn as a wealthy duke's daughter this time. The catch? The kingdom is quite literally crumbling due to the lack of architects. Vivielle may still be a child, but she has lifetimes' worth of training as an architect stored in her brain! If she rolls up her sleeves and gets to work, can she lay a strong foundation for her future and build back up hope in the kingdom?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Baby Land Lord Is Retiring
赤ちゃん建築家、これにて引退させていただきます

146025.description:
Be it forte or skill, the Wizard Elena’s capabilities were all rank-A at the top. However, even such an Elena had a few flaws; one being the height of her poverty, and another her immense debt! And the most devastating of her flaws was the fact that jewels were her medium for magic.

Then one day, she was recruited by the greatest household in the Borina Empire, the Mayfield Duchy, as an exclusively contracted Wizard. At the thought of being able to pay back all her debts at once, Elena accepted the offer. However, protecting the Duchy, which stood at odds with the Empress, was harder than expected.

To make things worse, the Duke of Mayfield, Cedric, who thought of Wizards as less than bugs, was turning out to be an obstacle for Elena. Will the opportunistic Wizard Elena be able to safely complete her task?

146026.description:
There is a dubious hall where there is a lady master who can solve the problem that no one can talk about. "There is no limit to the desire of a person, you must also become a monster in order not to be eaten by a monster."

Her rope wraps you and releases you. Like a pupa to be a butterfly. A strange customer will visit tonight …

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

title.native: サディスティック・ラヴァーグレイス

146027.description:
What’s better than a good meal? My name’s Jae-Ho and I love food. While some may call me a deadbEAT because I don’t have a job at the moment, I’m just your normal happy guy who loves eating and my girlfriend of 7 years. That is until I got a breakup text yesterday. Where did things go wrong? I keep trying to look back through the years, but I just can't figure it out...

(Source: WEBTOON)

146028.description:
Unassuming bookworm Tanaka Minato never imagined he'd cross paths with the cold beauty of his high school, Saito Rena. But after a chance encounter reveals their shared love of books, they start meeting in secret, bonding over literary discussions. To fund his hobby, Minato works part-time in disguise to avoid breaking the school's no-job policy. At work, he often seeks advice from his co-worker, Hiiragi Rena, about his peculiar situation. Yet, something about Hiiragi feels strangely familiar...

(Source: Manga UP!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: It Seems I Was Hitting On the Most Beautiful Girl in School Without Me Noticing

title.native: 俺は知らないうちに学校一の美少女を口説いていたらしい ～バイト先の相談相手に俺の想い人の話をすると彼女はなぜか照れ始める～
title.romaji: Ore wa Shiranai Uchi ni Gakkou Ichi no Bishoujo wo Kudoiteita Rashii: Baito Saki no Soudan Aite ni Ore no Omoibito no Hanashi wo Suru to Kanojo wa Nazeka Tere Hajimeru

146029.description:
I was reincarnated as the young lady of a Marquis. Emir Sharon, who has no significance in the novel and her goal is to live a peaceful life! I met the main characters of the original novel as kids in the imperial kindergarten, which I'm currently attending too. I can't believe that I'm meeting all the main characters! I was happy for a while but somehow, everyone doesn't seem to be so happy with me. But I can't miss the opportunity to build a strong connection with the future protagonists. Emir Sharon is on her quest to getting close to the main characters finally begins. And when I finally come to my senses, I'm in a situation where everyone is keeping each other on check just to take the seat right next to me.

What am I going to do with these kids who already glued themselves to me?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Notes: The chapter count includes a special episode.
synonyms: The Young Lady Tames the Male Leads
ちびっこ令嬢主人公たちを手なずける

title.english: The Little Lady Tames the Leads

146030.description:
The sequel to Zatch Bell! 100 demon children fought to determine the new king of the demon world. Once the war ended, the new king was crowned, and the demon world was at peace… or so you thought! The shocking reality of the current-day demon world is now revealed—and deep in the maw of despair, three demon children make a dangerous gambit.

(Source: Birgdin Board, translated)

146031.description:
Kyungho was an ordinary cook before being abducted and forced to fight off a demon invasion in another realm. Years later, he returns to his world, only to find it swarming with monsters. To make matters worse, he discovers that his mother and Earth's guardian deity, Carnis de Lupus, are dying. In order to save them and the world, Kyungho offers to serve Carnis revitalizing meals in return for healing his mother. But does Kyungho have what it takes to be both a hero and a cook?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Street Restaurant of a Returned Hero

146032.description:
Belle isn't the classic beauty who falls in love and marries the Beast. She's a gunslinging tomboy who's out to revive her family's dying business, and love is nothing but a distraction to her. But when her father has a costly run-in with the local Beast, Belle is forced into a contract with the Beast himself in order to repay the debt. And thus, this "tale as old as time" takes a complicated twist. Despite the growing fondness the Beast has for Belle, our spitfire heroine refuses to fall in love! As outside forces begin to squeeze their way into the pair's lives, Belle and the Beast continue to clash over their views on romance. Will the two be able to close the distance between them to make it to the end of their contract?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: Belle and the Beast's Labor Contract

146033.description:
Since his youth, Lee Se-Won has been fascinated with neuroscience, but now he’s taken it to the next level. He’s developed a method to hack directly into the brain and extract memories from the bodies of the deceased. When a private detective approaches Se-Won about using his discovery to solve crimes, the young scientist sees an opportunity to test his limits. But what he doesn’t see is the danger ahead. As Se-Won becomes embroiled in investigations, he realizes just how dangerous the mind can be.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

146034.description:
As a lonely orphan and a corporate heir, the lives of Seo Yeon-Woo and Lee Seok-Heon couldn’t be any more different. Due to this, Yeon-Woo has been unable to refuse Seok-Heon’s advances to be his sex partner. But as Seok-Heon’s grandfather was the one to take Yeon-Woo in when she was orphaned, the guilt of sleeping with her savior’s grandson weighs heavily on her mind. She finally draws the line when Seok-Heon pulls out a wedding ring, professing that he’s willing to go against his family’s wishes and marry Yeon-Woo. No longer wanting to become a burden to those around her, Yeon-Woo decides to pack her bags and run far away. But just when everything seems okay, Yeon-Woo learns that she has an unexpected baby on the way…

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

Note: Includes a prologue.

146035.description:
Dojun is a pretty ordinary guy. He’s a laid-back college student with a decent amount of friends and no notable scandals or troubles in his life. On the other hand, Haemin is his exact opposite: a fellow student with zero friends and a scandalous reputation with financial troubles following him wherever he goes. It’s really not the kind of lifestyle Dojun wants to be involved in. And yet, he can’t stop worrying about the perpetually bruised Haemin, which is why Dojun ends up worming his way into Haemin’s life…only to discover that there’s much more to him than the scandals say. Will Dojun be able to find the real Haemin buried under the injuries and rumors?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: The chapter count includes two bonus chapters.

146036.description:
Is he crazy? Or just the typical attention seeker?

Lee Gang-Jin, who doesn't understand the differences between people, and his Master Kwak-No who's the one helping him to understand the differences between people.

A warm human story of a student and his Master.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

146037.description:
The year is 1944, around when Miyafuji Yoshika joined the 501st JFW to protect Gallia.

The South European nation Romagna is launching a Neuroi counteroffensive with its 504th JFW, nicknamed The Ardor Witches. Its core is made up by the Duchy of Romagna's elite, the Red Pants Unit, but, what is soon becoming evident as the detachment is coming together, is that the members all seem to a bit peculiar, not the least of which the commander. What will destiny have in store for this group of girls...?

title.native: ストライクウィッチーズ 紅の魔女たち

146038.description:
“The emperor devours men,” the servants in the palace whisper. Han doesn’t believe them, until on his very first day of service he is dragged to the emperor’s bedchambers. Hunger and lust drives the tyranny that is rampant in the palace. Will Han be able to sate the tyrant and change him for the better?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: ปกรณัมรักราชาอสูร

146039.description:
The story starts with a deep kiss with a demon-woman, which awakened his SSS-level skill. What's going on here? Scheming loli, cool genius, innocent schoolgirl, and seductive demon as girlfriends... Faced with wave after wave of bad omens and misfortune, Lin Que feels like he's under a lot of pressure, when all he wants to do is to quietly farm monsters and level up until he's the strongest!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: Awakening SSS-Rank Skill After A Kiss

146040.description:
The reckless "summoning" by the girl links up two completely different worlds! The Ghost Immortal Qin Fengqin who was attacked during the trial unexpectedly breaks through to another Realm! The clash of the two civilizations ignites a brilliant spark, igniting the girl's path to become stronger.

(Source: MangaToon)

146041.description:
The pure fool + pervert Lim Tae-O dreams of a loving relationship. Because he's gay, he is estranged from his parents and at odds with his friends. Even the men he's dated can't overcome Tae-O's obsession, so he's been dumped many times. Thinking it's his last chance, he wants to finds a roommate to be his FWB... But then he meets Choi Hyeon, a roommate who suits Tae-O's taste more than he could have imagined! Like fate, he falls in love at first sight.

The strange co-habitation of Tae-O, who needs love, and Choi Hyeon, who needs attention. ♥
Can this love be successful?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

146042.description:
Hiiragi, a good-natured art student, has a secret hobby. He likes to listen in on people's lives using devices at home that receive radio waves from taxis and trucks. Despite his peaceful campus life, Hiiragi is facing a crisis. For some reason, he hasn't been able to get it up for the last 3 months, no matter what he did. One day, Hiiragi's crotch reacts to the panting sounds of a man on his radio. As Hiiragi searches for the guy with the erotic voice, the owner of the "panting sounds", a serious-looking, handsome librarian named Kurosuda shows up in front of him.

(Source: Kaiousha, translated)

Note: Contains one extra chapter.

146043.description:
Hayato is getting off to various livestreams when he comes across a man who is touching himself-and finds himself surprisingly into it. In fact, he's transfixed by the man's perky chest and slender fingers, which sport two distinctive moles. At work the next day, he sees the exact same moles on Mamiya, a younger coworker he's hardly spoken to before. At first, he figures it's a coincidence, but the next time he views the livestream, he can't help imagining the man as Mamiya...!

146053.description: The popular Ogawa romance depicts the love and hate of twin sisters who are being played by a strange destiny. The twin sisters Maho and Mio, who were born in 1945 as daughters of painters, are 17 years old. Instead of his ill father, Maho helped to live in a US military officer's house, and Mio began working at an antique shop while helping the mother's Japanese court. A work depicting the life of twin sisters who are at the mercy of fate of destiny.

146054.description: This is a story about Miro Takizawa, who was born and raised on the peaceful island of Sasaraijima, an island surrounded by mountains and ocean. This introverted girl has lived her first year in high school peacefully, falling in love and trying to make friends. Her peaceful life takes a sharp turn for the worse as she discovers the secrets of the "Tetsu-min." Dark secrets await her as these horrific entities endanger the inhabitants of this once peaceful island.

146055.description:
The century-long war with demons was finally brought to a close by seven young heroes who slew the demon lord, routed the demon army, and ultimately led humanity to victory. The heroes then went their separate ways, and the land has been at peace for twenty-five long years...until now. Alan Granger, a former hero, enjoys a quiet life as a commander in the Royal Knights until the day he receives a report that shakes him to his core: the demon army has returned! He immediately knows what he must do—gather his old compatriots and face the demon army once again. But Alan and his friends are now all in their forties, while the demons are more powerful than ever. Do these veteran heroes have what it takes to leap back onto the battlefield and save the world a second time?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

A cool beauty receives a confession from a delinquent... who wants to be her dog.
It is a romantic comedy.

This dog's trait: Strength.

146060.description:
Laritte Brumayer, the illegitimate daughter of a count grew up in an abusive household. As if that wasn't enough, she's sent to marry Duke Ian Reinhardt after he was killed and named a traitor, instead of her sister. Despite her dreary prospects of being a dead man's wife, Laritte is ecstatic to escape and start her new life! Just as she's settling in, Ian returns, claiming he was framed. Though wary of him at first, she agrees to help clear his name, oblivious to the hardships that lie ahead...

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: When the Count's Illegitimate Daughter Gets Married

146061.description:
Yui is a member of the "Itomusubi" family, who can see the red thread of destiny. She always supports people's love, but then the thread connects her to her natural enemy Kiriya, a member of the "Itokiri" family...?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

146063.description:

“Lee Doha, out of all those mackerels, which do you like the best?”

Hearing that question, Doha laughed out of disbelief.

“Why should it matter? They’re all the same”
“That’s exactly how I feel about you.”
“What do you mean?”
“I feel the same to you as I do to mackerel. I don’t feel anything.”
“...”
“So, stop messing around and back off, alright?”

As soon as he finished talking, he coldly dragged his cart over to the checkout. Doha, who watched him as he walked away, burst into astonishing laughter. After staring at the helpless mackerel, he turned to the back of Seo Junyoung’s head.

“But, I bet I’d taste the best!”

Junyoung quickly disappeared around the corner, pretending he didn’t hear anything.

Lee Doha, a 23-year-old virgin with a promiscuous mouth. Seo Junyoung, a 33-year-old “iron wall” who has gotten around.

Den is reborn as one of the most powerful magic users and is next in line to be chief of the fearsome Crow Tribe. But Den intends to keep his promise and runs off to the capital to become a civil servant. With a cast of colorful roommates, a family hunting him down, and a shadowy plot to overthrow the empire, can Den actually achieve his simple life goal?

146139.description:
Jia Han, a 32-year-old freelancer with no work, is tired of her parents nagging her to get married and finally move out. When she runs into her childhood friend, Mincheol Jin, who is also feeling the same pressure from his parents, she blurts out that they should just get married to solve both of their problems. Little did she know he’d accept her suggestion, and she suddenly finds herself thrust into marriage. A story of an unexpected romance that’ll have you scrolling for more!

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: Match Made in Heaven by Chance
โชคชะตานำพารัก

146141.description:
Eom Ji-Cheok was just an underappreciated hunter's assistant until an odd dream and a simple thumbs up triggered his awakening as a hunter and hot GodTube influencer. Ji-Cheok doesn't earn points by killing monsters though. Instead, he must do good deeds and gain the approval of others. So when a heroic video of him goes viral and top companies start wooing him with contracts, it seems like the sky's the limit. But will fame be a more dangerous game than our rising star expected...?

(Source: Tapas)

146142.description:
In the middle of Mt. Fu Yun and on the banks of Lake Egret, there is a school called tao yuan academy, which houses the children of imperial and wealthy families. Su Li's twin sister, Su Li, who was intelligent and sensitive at an early age, was given an imperial order to study at tao yuan academy. however as the start of school was just around the corner, Su Li (the sister) ran away with a handsome young foreign boy... to avoid the punishments of lying to the emperor, Su Li (the brother) had to dress up as a woman and attend tao yuan academy in place of his sister. Initially, he wanted to keep things low-key, but to his dismay, he had caught the attention of multiple suitors... Hey, we're all brothers, can't we settle this peacefully! Stop it! Don't run away you rascal! Damn it, what do you guys have that I don't?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.english: How To Raise A Cross Dressing Master

146143.description:
Hijiri Amamiya, an introverted loner, turned down a sudden confession from Ema Kohanai, the most popular girl in school.
Since that day, Kohanai-san started acting strangely.
She plastered herself to him on the train, deliberately flipped up her skirt to flash him on the stairs... Finally, she pushed him down in the gym...!?!

(Source: G-Walk, translated)

Rin Ando speed-ran into marriage after reuniting with a guy from college.
Her younger husband is a bit of a neat freak, always putting things into its proper place.
But he still hasn't put it in his wife yet...?

(Source: Weekly Manga Times, translated)

146151.description:
College student Ayumu Chiba is handsome enough to draw constant attention, but since he's a red-faced crybaby, his only friend is a cat named Ai. When his beloved Ai passes away, fellow cat-lover Haruki Konno takes him under his wing, and he develops feelings for him. However, when Haruki's nephew Hiro shows up one day, Ayumu immediately realizes Hiro has identified him as competition. Worse, he becomes victim to Hiro's bullying...! This is a cat-filled love story between an arrogant younger man and a handsome, antisocial crybaby who get turned down by the same person.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Chapter count includes one extra chapter.

146155.description:
When failed martial artist Kwak Noh is tasked with protecting a group of young orphans, he plans to send them off to good homes. However, after growing attached to the children, he decides to raise them all as disciples of the Shadowless Clan. But as times get tough, Kwak Noh is forced to journey far from home to make money, leaving Sunyu, first brother of the clan, to provide for his siblings. If Sunyu wants to step up for his clan, though, he'll need to step up his skills! Training begins now!

(Source: Tapas)

146159.description: Hagoromo Aoba is a mangaka best known for her series revolving around delicious meals. Inaba Nichiro is assigned to be her assistant, but discovers a shocking secret: Hagaromo-sensei is a massive canned food nut!

虚妄の女王〜辺境警備外伝〜
title.romaji: Kyomou no Joou: Henkyou Keibi Gaiden

146161.description:
Saul Kadaf, a delinquent middle-aged man, was demoted from his job in the capital and sent to the borderlands due to numerous woman-related issues. Not a single person lives north of the border, and the only job he has is herding cattle... But he is welcomed by some cute soldiers and a handsome young priest named Jenias Rosai. He begins a new life with the kind people of the borderlands, but sometimes unexpected events occur...

(Source: Usio Publishing)

title.native: チアエルフがあなたの恋を応援します！
title.romaji: Cheer Elf ga Anata no Koi wo Ouen Shimasu!

146163.description:
One day, countless dungeons suddenly appeared in the world, and humanity ushered in the "dungeon era". Adesalai, the boss of an abyss-level dungeon, was killed by human adventurers via despicable means. Vowing revenge, he was reincarnated as a weak adventurer, but he activated an exclusive Boss System. Using the system's cheating powers to conquer dungeons and becoming its master, he started on the road of revenge.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

146164.description:
10,000 years after the time of "A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality," in the Spirit realm, the fox girl Liu Le'er's clan was wiped out by the Blood Saber sect, and she was being hunted down herself. Suffering from multiple injuries, Liu Le'er hid under a rock, just when the three pursuing cultivators were about to cut her down, the rock suddenly burst open, and an ordinary-looking man emerges from inside...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality—Immortal World Arc

title.english: A Record Of A Mortal's Journey To Immortality—Immortal World Arc

146165.description:
They call her a monster… but to this admiral, she’s a sacred descendant of the sea! Rudia Flang has been mistreated her whole life, so when the emperor arranges her marriage to Alexander Cilia, war hero and the youngest admiral in history, she cowers in fear at the thought of marrying a violent seaman. As this ocean voyage treks on, she’s met with benevolence from the Sercilian Island people who, unbeknownst to her, find the scales glistening on her body far from the marking of a monster...

(Source: Tapas)

146166.description:
Rainier Cavalier is a handsome duke burdened with an enormous debt. Henrietta Cortez is a wealthy yet neglected heiress. When Rainier’s friend suggests that he “bride-kidnap” Henrietta as a means to relieve his financial woes, he does just that. However, he wasn’t expecting Henrietta to be so beautiful, nor was he expecting her to propose a marriage of convenience that would improve both their lives. Are these two merely business partners in this unusual arrangement? Or could deeper feelings blossom from a simple “marriage by capture?"

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: อุ้มวิวาห์★ยัยมาดมัวแซลล์

146167.description:
Several hundred years have passed since the fierce battles using Mobile Suits throughout the universe. After many wars, earthlings forgot how to make developments in their own civilization. Some humans moved to the moon. For a very, very long time, they dreamed about returning to earth. When Planet Earth regained its standard of living to that of the days of the Industrial Revolution, Dianna Soreil, the Queen of the Moon entered into negotiations with the head of Planet Earth so that the Moonrace could return. She also secretly dispatched a reconnaissance troop to check the environmental and living conditions on Planet Earth. Loran Cehack came to Earth as part of the troop. Almost drowned in a river, he was saved by two beautiful sisters, Kihel and Sochie. After the accident, he started working for a mine, owned by the father of these sisters. He soon gets used to living on Planet Earth.

Two years pass and the Moonrace who are becoming impatient with the slow negotiations takes action and forcefully tries to return to Earth. Flames engulf the streets. The "Turn 'A' Gundam" appears from the White Doll Ruins and Loran finds himself riding it. He becomes the savior of Planet Earth. Loran's struggle to avoid war between the Moon and Planet Earth begins.

146168.description:
A young man picked up a vampire girl who collapsed in the street. Although she tries to serve him wholeheartedly to repay him for his blood, she is too clumsy to succeed. A warm slife-of-life interspecies vampire comedy where nobody is left behind or abandoned!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.
synonyms: Please Give Me Your Blood, I Will Serve You In Gratitude

title.native: お役に立つので血をください
title.romaji: Oyaku ni Tatsu node Chi wo Kudasai

146169.description:
Miyako, a former adult-video actress, was reunited with a former acting partner on a blind date...? Their pure and innocent love for each other, connected by their secret past, is more explosive than you can imagine! You will surely be healed by this cute romantic comedy with a unique twist.

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

Note: This was originally published as a doujin on the website Rookie Jump since July 1st, 2021. On August 18th, 2021; it was announced that the manga was going to be officially serialized on the website and app Shounen Jump + since March 29th, 2022. The three chapters of the original doujin were re-published as part of the official serialization.
synonyms: More Than Lovers, Less Than Friends

146170.description:
Su and Jin-O, who were forced to eat yellow mites by bullies at school, undergo mysterious changes to their bodies and gain the powers of a blob monster.

(Source: Kakao Webtoons, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

146172.description:
Masahiro, the delinquent son of a Yakuza leader, and Tsubaki, a famous crosdressing make-up artist, are in a long-distance Osaka-to-Tokyo relationship. However, Masahiro’s younger brother and Tsubaki’s supporter is their go-between. Because of this, Masahiro begins to feel inferior to Tsubaki and worries if it’s okay for him to stay as he is…?!

(Source: Shinsokan, translated)

146175.description:
"Look... I've put it inside you, Mayu. ...Oh god, you look way too sexy when you're feeling it." ...His skillful, long, wet, fingers slowly trace the curves of my body... No, stop!! My nurse uniform is going to come flying off...!
Mayu, a novice nurse, and Ryohei, an excellent doctor three years her senior who's the heir to the hospital, grew up together. He's sweet and popular with the ladies. Mayu, never having had a boyfriend before, could never win the heart of a guy like him...! Or, so she thought. Suddenly, out of nowhere, she finds herself engaged to be his bride...!?

(Source: Renta)

Note: This was released first as 6 parts that were sold in three chapters.

146178.description:
Cloud birds that soar through the blue sky; Terrorblood wolves that roam the wastelands ruthlessly. Dream beasts that dart through the moonlight forests; Ghost kings that dwell on foggy cliffs. Ocean spirit beasts that haunt the depths of the boundless oceans; thousand-eyed treants that stand unyielding on precipitous peaks.

Sword Beetles, Sunset Eagles, Ancient Wood Demons, Chaotic Thunder Sprites, Cursed Demon Fox: Ice… Plants, Beasts, Elementals, Undead, this is the eccentric, variegated, beautiful, and stunning world of soul pets!

Our protagonist, a soul pet trainer, had at first a young, mutated soul pet – a Moonlight Fox. In unending fights, it mutated into the stronger Evil Flamed Six-tailed Demon fox and the even higher leveled Queen Flamed Nine-tailed Firefox!

Under the companionship of this soul pet, he walked on the path to become a king, catching precious and rare soul pets, and never ceasing his endeavor to becoming the very best!

146179.description:
Wang Po slept for three thousand years. When he woke up, he got a job as the dormitory custodian of the Cultivation Girls' School. Now he can freely enter the girls' dormitory, as rich heiresses throw themselves at him and demon girls fall for his charms. See how a little dorm custodian use his powers to carry these girls to new heights of cultivation!

(Source: Kuaikan,translated)
synonyms: Cultivation Girls' School: All Girls Want to Put Me Down
Xiuzhen Girls' School: All Girls Want to Put Me Down

146181.description:
Spica Virgo is an apprentice witch, but can’t use any magic. She needs someone to be her master in order to get into the academy of her dreams, but she has no money and no connections. Suddenly, a mysterious talking black cat that can use magic appears before her!! Spica wants to learn magic, and the black cat wants his curse broken—goals on the same path. Therefore, a secret master-apprentice relationship was born! But the key to breaking the curse is kissing his…?! A clumsy witch and the teachings of a black cat—the magic academy fantasy starts here!!

(Source: K MANGA)

Shouldering the mission of mastering his own destiny and following in the footsteps of the elder generation, he, sword in hand, is standing up and showing courage in adversity, bringing out the best in him and embarking on the road to success!

(Source: WeComics)

146188.description:
With the appearance of the Overlord’s Star in the sky, the world plunges into chaos, and only the one born with the essence of the star can save it. Amidst the upheaval, former comrades Baek Woonhoi and Chun Ryuyoung each dream of becoming the Overlord. Ryuyoung to save his family, and Woonhoi because he has nothing else to lose. But as the star shines brighter, the two find themselves swept up in an impending war. Both men’s ambitions burn fiercely, but only one Overlord can reign supreme!

(Source: Tapas)

"We're still married tonight though?" It's the night before our divorce, but he fills me up completely... Could it be that we're the most physically compatible...!?

146196.description:
Years after their physical relationship seemingly ended, Kou appears before Risei again as the Family’s Wakagashira. Having previously been asked by the Kumichou to look after Kou to ensure that his son lives a regular life, Risei is bewildered by Kou’s sudden return and his assignment to work directly under Kou. Risei wonders why Kou, someone who seemed to dislike the Yakuza in the past, became the Wakagashira. Kou then declares, “I did this to make you mine”…

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

title.romaji: Kurayami no Ryuu wa Tonbo wo Idaku

146197.description:
On their second wedding anniversary, Ichiro Wako came home after work to find his wife having sex with another man...! After the divorce, Wako lost his home, his happiness, and the love of his life, but then...!

(Source: Young Jump, translated)

146198.description:
Wisteria, the daughter of a count, secretly has feelings for Bright, a beautiful childhood friend and son of a duke who, unable to use magic, had been conducting forbidden research in the shadows. Devastated when Bright confesses his love for her younger sister, Wisteria is even more hurt when he asks her to take her sister's place as a sacrifice. Is her love for Bright so strong that she will give up her life for him?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

title.english: The Person I Loved Asked Me to Die in My Sister's Stead
title.native: 恋した人は、妹の代わりに死んでくれと言った。―妹と結婚した片思い相手がなぜ今さら私のもとに？と思ったら―@COMIC

146200.description:
His inscrutable actions leading me on, making my pulse race.
I keep looking at his smile, wondering what he's really thinking?

(Source: Bessatsu Margaret, translated)

146201.description:
Victorian London in the 19th century, lit by gas lamps blurred by the fog. Our hero visits the Black Museum, a crime archive in Scotland Yard and the "curator" of historical horrors. She requests to see the curator's red boots... the remains of a mysterious incident that took place at a ball hosted by the Queen. The woman then recounts the story of a very strange swordsman. The long-awaited latest installment in Kazuhiro Fujita's popular "Ushio-Tora" and "Karakuri Circus" series!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

146203.description:
Seishiro Nagi, a second-year high schooler, thought everything was a pain and lived his life in an apathetic fog. That is, until he met Reo Mikage and they entered the mysterious striker training center, Blue Lock...

A new spin-off from Blue Lock's author, Muneyuki Kaneshiro, telling the story from Nagi's point of view!

(Source: K-Manga)

146204.description:
Transmit warmt… First and final love call.♥

(Source: fakku)

146205.description:
If I destroy the human race - then will you stay with me?

A hero took on the task of defeating the Demon Lord for the sake of world peace. When he arrived at the Demon Lord's castle, he was greeted by the Demon Lord herself with a marriage certificate ready to go! The hero was puzzled by the Demon King's strong desire for him. A love comedy about the world's survival between a stubbornly in-love Demon Lord and a tsundere hero!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

146207.description:
I want to do it like college students do it!! ❤

(Source: FAKKU)

Hino Harukaze is not confident about her appearance. Her classmates call her "ugly" and make fun of her. Then, a delinquent boy in her class, Kurobane Rao, told Hino that she is "cute"⁉

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

146214.description:
Fifty years ago, he transmigrated into Dragon City, a lone fierce fighter who raised Earth's banner to fight against the tide of fearsome alien monsters. Fifty years later, Meng Chao was reverted back to the time before the invasion, reborn with a system that made him stronger with every contribution he made. In this life, he will smash the monsters, stomp the demons, and tear down the old gods. In this life, he swore he will rewrite his own, his family's, and even the entire humanity's final fate!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

146218.description:
Imamura Seima is a sophomore in high school who spends his days in a village where the stars have disappeared from the night sky. One day, he meets a mysterious silver-haired girl named Plea Momobell.

Plea happens to be a new student and upon joining Seima's class, she suddenly announces that she plans to revive the Starry Night Festival. And when Seima accidentally discovers the girl's "secret", he and his friends Eito and Chiyuri decide to help her...

title.native: 星空☆アゲイン ～君と過ごした奇跡のひと夏～

Young salaryman Mutsuki Hotei gets the surprise of his life when his senior coworker Nakamura drags him to a so-called "snack bar" - especially when he gets enchanted by Snack Bar Metadoll's own "diva," Ichiko!

146222.description:
The hit social network game "The Magical Girl Raising Project" selects one out of every tens of thousands of players to become a real life magical girl. The lucky chosen girls gain magic powers as well as incredibly good fortune, and spend their days blissfully. But one day, an absolute announcement declares that the number of magical girls has risen too high and must be cut down to half. Sixteen young maidens are thrust into a merciless, deadly contest to survive...but how many will come out the other side?

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: 魔法少女育成計画 restart

146223.description:
The violence continues in the 4th installment of Magical Girl Raising Project. Numbers dwindle as alliances grow. Do these girls have what it takes to win it all!?

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: 魔法少女育成計画 episodes

146224.description:
A whole new batch of magical girls!

During what was supposed to be a typical after-school club meeting, a small fairy named Toko appears out of nowhere with incredible news: All seven attendees have what it takes to become full-fledged magical girls! In exchange for their newfound abilities, they promise to save Toko from the evil mages who are hunting her down. But the girls may be in over their heads, as these bad guys have special magical girl powers of their own...

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: 魔法少女育成計画 limited

146225.description:
What makes a magical girl special?

Sakura Kagami is just an ordinary girl, and her magical-girl persona, Prism Cherry, is just as ordinary, too. After the same old tired routine of saving people with her boring magic in a peaceful town, Sakura learns that her classmate, Nami, is also a magical girl. The two of them become fast friends, but it doesn't take long before the veneer of magical-girl-hood falls apart to reveal something more sinister than they'd ever anticipated.

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: 魔法少女育成計画 JOKERS

146226.description:
"Classic of Mountains and Seas" said that there were once sixteen dieties with their arms intertwined, watching over Emperor on this wilderness.

(Source: Wecomics)

146227.description:
Jia Fugui is a girl who became impoverish after her mother died, leaving her homeless on the streets. She suddenly gets invited to play the "Poverty Game" where she pretends to be rich and find love. As Jia Fugui experiences the life of luxury in a prestigious school, her mission for love begins.

(Source: INKR)

title.romaji: "Pinqiong Youxi", Wei Le 5000 Wan Tan Lianai

146228.description:
Tragedy strikes when Selene’s parents pass away, and her family loses everything. With no other option at her disposal, she works multiple jobs to provide for her siblings. Luckily an opportunity for financial security arises; all she must do is marry the duchess’s son, Armand, and produce an heir. But the home situation Selene enters is complex, and Armand, once a great commander, is housebound with a mysterious condition. She’s determined to find the root of his illness, but she might drudge up some skeletons in the closet instead...

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Contractual Marriage to a Surly Duke

146229.description:
One day, ‘Geum Maru’ was attacked by an unknown monster and received help from the revenger, ‘Jay White’, who hunts down evil.

‘Geum Maru’ used that incident as a pretext to get involved in a war that has been going on for a long time between the Evil and the Revengers…

146230.description:
A modern man is reincarnated into the world of a fantasy game he knows well: as Werner, the son of a powerful noble. The thing is, Werner isn’t the hero or even the villain–he’s a background character likely to die during a climactic siege! Werner seeks out and befriends the hero, but he doesn’t have powerful enough skills to be a hero himself. Unwilling to die as a later plot point, Werner uses his knowledge of the game and his power as a noble to aid the hero and defend against evil attacks. That’s when he realizes that when he does so, he saves other people who were doomed as he was, which changes the “plot” he thought was inevitable. As the hero’s close comrade who can see the future, perhaps Werner will be a savior to this place, after all!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Behind the Scene of Heroic Tale...

146231.description:
Zhi Banyi has a secret. His heart only beats faster when he listens to a streamer called "Dust Under the Light" speak... So, Zhi Banyi decided to go see a psychiatrist. He never could have imagined that his psychiatrist would be the "female" streamer that made his heart beat every night!

146236.description:
A heartfelt story between an ordinary man and his beloved cats.

Mikami is an average illustrator that lives with two kittens. With his work falling into a slump, eating only flavorless meals, and being overall depressed, God gives him a sudden surprise!

His beloved cats take the form of human children. With hungry bellies awaiting, Mikami rushes to make food for them. Even just salmon onigiri can be delicious when eaten with two people.

(Source: Pixiv Comic, translated)

146237.description:
Setsuna Sugimoto is summoned to another world as the 68th hero only to be abandoned because of his weak and sickly constitution. But everything changes when he’s given a third chance at life by his dear friend Kyle, the former hero, thereby inheriting his vast knowledge, power, and lifeforce. Freed from the tethers of his past, Setsuna begins a journey as an adventurer where he’ll encounter all walks of life, each experience bound to leave their mark on both him and his world.

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: The Ephemeral Scenes of Setsuna's Journey

146238.description:
Oriana, a seventeen-year-old magic student, suddenly dies alongside her boyfriend, Vincent. However, she returns from death in the body of her seven-year-old self with the memories of her past life intact–except for the knowledge of what killed her. She fantasizes for years about reuniting with her beloved, but when they finally meet, Vincent doesn't remember her! Can she make Vincent fall in love with her again and avoid the death that started this mysterious time loop?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Got 6th place in the 18th Manga Taisho Awards (2025).

146240.description: The kind-hearted boy Suzuki was supposed to use his cheat ability to be “unconditionally loved by the local race” and enjoy a peaceful slow life in another world… or so he thought. However, due to a small mistake by a goddess, he was actually reincarnated into a bloody, end-of-the-century world where humans were being destroyed by demons, with slaughter and torture everywhere. Suzuki was in a desperate situation!! …But for some reason, the demons who saw him seemed to be acting a little strange – what could this mean?

146241.description:
An omega who was pretending to be a beta is suddenly the mate of a top tier alpha!?

It happened one night on their way home from a company drinking party. When Mr. Hashida takes care of the drunken Mr. Hayashi, just a small amount of Mr. Hashida's omega pheromones is enough to drive Mr. Hayashi into a frenzy. Despite his resistance, Mr. Hayashi not only has his body taken, but Mr. Hayashi bites his neck indicating that they've become mates. However, it seems Mr. Hayashi remembers nothing from that night... Mr. Hashida considers himself lucky and continues to pretend to be a beta. He decides to hide that he's his mate forever, but Mr. Hayashi (an alpha) keeps desiring his body!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Chapter count includes one extra.

146242.description:
University student Yoshiyuki and his boyfriend Yuzu have moved in together, and things are going great. Yuzu's not always the most open about his feelings, but natural nurturer Yoshiyuki is happy to coddle him a bit. There's just one problem!! Yuzu is totally new to dating, and even a single kiss leaves him beet-red with embarrassment, so these two aren't getting anywhere in the bedroom... Dreaming of all the hot and heavy fun they could be having, Yoshiyuki makes a deal with Yuzu to make their one-month anniversary their first night together. When the day finally arrives, will Yuzu be up to the task...?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

146244.description:
After being summoned to another world as the 68th hero, Setsuna Sugimoto is abandoned by that same world due to his sickly constitution. But when he meets Kyle, a millennia-old former hero like him, Setsuna is given a third chance at life—inheriting Kyle’s knowledge, power, and even life force. Now able to travel the world as an adventurer, Setsuna will encounter people from all walks of life, with each meeting bound to leave a lasting mark on himself and the world. And so begins a journey full of firsts...

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: The Ephemeral Scenes of Setsuna's Journey

title.english: The Ephemeral Scenes of Setsuna’s Journey

146245.description:
Ju Hee-yeon, the newly crowned emperor of the powerful Jewon Empire, possesses unparalleled authority and control over everything…except for one persistent affliction: an unrelenting fever, borne from his condition to carry the powers of the dragon. As his fevers worsen and desperation takes hold, an unexpected remedy presents itself in the form of Yeo-heun, a half-goblin rumored to possess the ability to absorb and nullify others’ heat. Intrigued, Hee-yeon seeks solace in an enchanting night shared with Yeo-heun. However, the emperor soon finds himself captivated beyond his expectations by the goblin’s endearing charm. As time passes and Hee-yeon recognizes deeper feelings stirring within his own heart, he begins to question if his infatuation with Yeo-heun is truly only a consequence of the heat of the moment…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes 6 extras.

146246.description:
Pandora is a bustling new planet where fiction merges with reality… and it’s on the brink of destruction! People everywhere signed contracts that unwittingly bind their souls with demons, causing mysterious calamities to ravage Pandora. Hector is a detective who brings misfortune wherever he goes, while Eustino is a vampire and priest on a quest. Together, they take it upon themselves to prevent the looming apocalypse. With each contract broken and power gained, will they defeat a nefarious cult’s doomsday scheme and help Pandora break free?

(Source: Tapas)

The beautiful cooking prodigy Wuzai accidentally ate monster-meat one time and was amazed at its taste. She was determined to create an entire cookbook based on monsters. Watch them get together for an incredible monster-hunting culinary adventure!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The Monster Is Ready for Dinner!

A clash of magical-girl titans!

Snow White, a.k.a. the Magical-Girl Hunter, is searching for her dear friend Ripple when she's summoned by one of the Three Sages, the Magical Kingdom's highest authority. The Sage asks Snow White to locate a missing magical girl-a simple enough task that ends up throwing her into the middle of a bloody war between two opposing Sage factions. Meanwhile, Princess Deluge is on the warpath, hell-bent on avenging her fallen comrades...which puts her and Snow White's allies in conflict!

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: 魔法少女育成計画 ACES

146253.description:
Blood, sweat, tears, and some laughs in between!

From the very first Magical Girl Raising Project all the way to Magical Girl Raising Project ACES, dozens of magical girls have found a special place in our hearts. Though it may seem like they spend their days fighting one bloody battle after another, there's more to these magical girls than meets the eye! This collection of eleven bonus stories includes some of their lighter exploits and even gives a few glimpses of the girls' lives as regular teenagers!

(Source: Yen Press)

Outed in high school?!

In the middle of the night, high schooler Jung-Yoon sends a teary text to her ex-girlfriend in the hopes of winning her back. But much to her horror, she discovers that she's actually sent it to Do-Young, the most anti-social girl in her class! Will she be outed at school?!

146256.description:
Rei had died at the young age of 17, but as he was about to move on, he was summoned back to the realm of the living as a teddy bear by his witch girlfriend, who seeks to be together with him forever and ever.

"I didn't want to lose."
A high school girl enters a relationship with her upperclassman.

146259.description:
"It’s not that I don’t want to get married. I just want to be accepted for who I am. Is that so much to ask...?"

Suzu is a thirtyish woman with a cute-and-fluffy exterior that belies a strength no man can hope to match. But when she tells off her insistent mother by saying she’ll only marry a man stronger than she is, she’s set up with... a ninja?!? Is that his job...? How does he earn a living...? But Akitsuki the Ninja just smiles away, oblivious to Suzu’s confusion. There’s no way she could take him, and yet this kindhearted man, who nonchalantly accepts the true self that put off every other suitor she’s ever had, secretly makes Suzu’s heart flutter...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: This is What Ninja Love's All About

146260.description:
Jung-Hoo is an orphan. After losing his parents way too young, he has no money and few prospects. The only person looking out for him is the gorgeous Ms. Lee. With her help, Jung-Hoo’s scraped by so far… but when Ms. Lee asks him to move in, he’s faced with a different type of hardship - seeing her curvy body in those revealing clothes every day drives him wild! With all that sexual tension in the air, it isn’t long before Jung-hoo and Ms. Lee are giving each other a helping hand…! Living under one roof isn’t easy, but it has its perks!

(Source: Lezhin X)
synonyms: 一つ屋根の下～甘く危険な熟女の香り～

146261.description:
Mei works at her family's small diner where one of their regulars can't seem to remember their no smoking policy. She enjoys working there, but it doesn't leave her much room for romance. So, when she bumps into the smoker outside of work, she didn't expect much to happen. So, how did they end up at a hotel watching adult movies? She doesn't even know his name! Can she forget what happened that night? Or will he order another serving...?

(Source: Renta!)

Lucas Sylvia. A college student. One morning, he wakes up in a room with three girls. What happened, and what should he do now?

(Source: Toomics)
synonyms: 俺、これからどうしよう？
昨夜の記憶がないんだが、どうやら全員と…

146263.description:
Demonically scary x secretly shy x dessert loving = heartthrob moé boss!! One day, Kasumi Mugino, a writer for a women’s magazine, loses a photo of a past she wants to leave buried in the dark. After searching high and low for it, what she found was… her boss with the worst workplace rating in the company (because he’s as scary as a demon), Hibiki Hasegawa, in the middle of making desserts!? Completely shocked, she shouts in surprise, and Hasegawa sees her… and though she thought he was one real demon of a boss, he’s actually harshly sweet! Sweetly harsh! A super sweet boss!? Enjoy a taste of this 1000% sugar overloaded office romcom that’s so sweet, it’ll practically give a heart attack!

まあまあまあ、ちゃんと魔王は倒しますから、一回だけ　クラフトビール編

146267.description:
Jiang He, a girl from the Tang Dynasty, jumped a thousand years into the future and appeared in front of Xu Qing. The love that spanned a thousand years brought them together as if by fate. Everything she knew had become ancient history. Relatives, friends, and enemies have all been left 1,200 years in the past. The boy will do anything to help this girl start a new life. Pain, confusion, cheers, and laughter will be made anew in the modern world.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

While out on a booze run, Yoshika's boyfriend spots a display of sexy cosplay outfits and his eyes light up. Yoshika staunchly refuses, but her boyfriend begs, and only after promising to do her share of the chores does Yoshika agree. She starts out her roleplay as a sadistic delinquent maid who scolds her idiot master, but when push comes to shove, he reminds her who the servant is!

(Source: Fakku!)

There is a monster living in my parents' house. My brother, named...

It was the summer of my 29th year. After I was furloughed from work, I went back to my parents' house for the first time in a while. Who is that guy living thereーー

(Source: Big Comic Bros, translated)

146274.description:
REVISIT THE ORIGINAL SIXTEEN!
Learn more about the sixteen magical girls from the very first Magical Girl Raising Project in this short story collection that perfectly complements the hit anime series. You'll read about the girls' normal, everyday lives, some surprising interactions, and even events that took place before the game's start! These sweet vignettes are positively bursting with magical-girl charm!

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: Magical Girl Raising Project: Peaceful Days of 16 Magical Girls
title.native: 魔法少女育成計画 16人の日常
title.romaji: Mahou Shoujo Ikusei Keikaku: 16-nin no Nichijou

146275.description:
WILL YOU BE MY FRIEND?

​Puk Puck’s plan to reform the Magical Kingdom is proceeding smoothly now that she has the help of her new friends Shadow Gale and Snow White…but friendship only goes so far. Uluru has defected from the Puk Faction in order to aid the magical girl Pfle, who has several risky tricks up her sleeve to stop Puk Puck’s devious scheme. What kinds of drastic measures will Pfle and her allies take to rescue the brainwashed Shadow Gale and Snow White?

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: 魔法少女育成計画 QUEENS

146276.description:
MAGIC IS IN THE AIR!

​The popular magical-girl battle royal series returns with a collection of short stories hot off the press! These vignettes are jam-packed with dozens of magical girls from across the series, from the very first entry up to Magical Girl Raising Project: QUEENS—and even a few characters from the web manga Magical Girl Raising Project: F2P. Whether you’re a hard-core fan or have only seen the anime, this book has something for everyone!

(Source: Yen Press)

146277.description:
With only 15 students in total, and all girls at that, Umemizaki Junior High’s Class 2-F is a bit peculiar. In fact, “peculiar” doesn’t even cut it—this is a special class that the Magical Kingdom created to raise the next generation of legitimate magical girls! From the outside, these elite students represent a beacon of hope for the future. But behind closed doors, something terrible is brewing…

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: 魔法少女育成計画「黒（ブラック）」

146278.description:
An experiment gone wrong leads to the death of a famous mage, and the passing of this illustrious individual sends the Magical Kingdom into mourning. Then, a few months later, the deceased mage’s relations receive letters from his proxy regarding the inheritance of his estate, inviting them to a tiny uninhabited island the mage had used as a getaway cottage/research lab. When Mana gets one of these letters, she’s skeptical, but after careful consideration, she contacts two magical-girl friends to accompany her there...

(Source: Yen Press)

146279.description:
SECRETS, SCHEMES, AND SURPRISES AT EVERY TURN

Snow White has infiltrated a class of magical girls in order to stop a conspiracy to overthrow the Magical Kingdom, but an unforeseen plot sees one classmate after another falling victim to foul play. Meanwhile, Ripple comes out of hiding to take down Frederica with the support of the First Lapis Lazuline. Will she and Snow White finally be reunited?

(Source: Yen Press)

Fairy Luo Yue of the Cloudtop Sect used to be a pure and pretty rare talent, yet got knocked off the Parting Cliff and imprisoned for over ten years by her master just because she wanted to marry his senior brother! Surprisingly, after she died, she became Tu Huan, leader of the Pleasure Sect who enjoyed torturing men and doing all kinds of evil things! What shocked her more was that her handsome and powerful master and all her well-behaved disciples all turned evil!

(Source: Webnovel)

146284.description:
Behind the graceful and perfect honor student Mari is a demonic sex fiend that feeds on semen by night. But this time, she's been stopped in the act by some powerful incubi, and her power to invade dreams is stolen away from her.
The condition for her full release? A week without climaxing under full pleasurable titillation in the dream world.

146286.description:

Kimimura is rumored to be able to use psychic teleportation. However, the restrictions are severe. It can only be used when the wind is blowing, and he can only move one meter per meter of wind speed. His classmates lose interest in his uninteresting ability.......!

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

146367.description:
Shunya and Ryota are honor students attending a prestigious high school exclusively for male alphas. And while their alpha nature places them at the top of the social hierarchy, these two friends hope to one day create new medicines that help omegas instead and put an end to the discrimination they face. But everything changes in an instant when Shunya suddenly manifests as an omega himself and goes into heat! With his best friend now vulnerable to attack by their alpha classmates, will Ryota be able to protect him and realize their dream? Or will they both fall prey to the instincts they’ve tried so hard to resist?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

146373.description:
In a world where magic is an everyday fact of life, just about everyone is able to use it... Well, except Luca... She has to rely on her older brother Glen and the young beastman Abel. She's still trying, though, because her goal is to be as great a witch as her incredible mother.
One day, a mysterious, black-robed witch claiming to be an acquaintance of Luca's mother gave her an unusual fruit... "Take a bite and your true powers will awaken." And Luca did just that. The moment she did, however, something strange happened to her body. That's how Luca discovered she was the daughter of an incredibly powerful demon. The fruit undid the seal her mother had placed on her powers, causing her magic to run wild and endanger her life. The only way to save her was to pour semen (magical energy) into her body, neutralizing her own energies. And so, in the spirit of charity, Glen and Abel had sex with Luca. A sweet scent exudes from her newly-empowered body, and the two men are helpless to resist. Which is good, because she's going to need a lot of energy at all times of day to keep her powers in check!
synonyms: The Magic School Dropout Was a Powerful Succubus

146374.description: One day, Yuki's friend introduces her to her new boyfriend. He was the type of guy who didn't seem right for the girl he was with, but as long as her friend was happy, Yuki decided she'd give him her blessing. Then one day she goes out for drinks, blacks out, and wakes up in a man's apartment. She was undressed, and a man was groping her. It was her friend's boyfriend! And compared to Yuki's own man, his cock was unbelievable. She didn't want to betray her boyfriend, but... that dick, though....

Eris Boreas Greyrat takes center stage in this spinoff from the wildly popular series, Jobless Reincarnation! After facing a devastating defeat at the hands of Dragon God Orsted at the Red Wyrm's Lower Jaw mountain range, Eris parts ways with Rudeus and makes her way to the Sword Sanctum in order to rectify her own inexperience as a swordsman. As the "Mad Dog" continues to hone her sword skills under the tutelage of the Sword God, her fangs continue to grow stronger and sharper!

A campus love battle between a calculating girl and a natural boy to see who will fall first!

A guy with a pretty face, smart brains, attentive, and sensible, he's the perfect catch! Rio, a girl who doesn't miss, has her eye on Kawakita-kun, an innocent but strong-willed opponent...!

(Source: Sho-Comi, translated)

The student council president, Kaoru Inuzuka, is known as the "police dog" due to her strict discipline. However, when she gets hungry, she's more like an eager little puppy! The vice-president Ken Kaino is the only one who knows her secret, and a "feeding comedy" will unfold!

When architect Jae embarks on a solo vacation to Spain, it may seem that she’s running from her past, away from her abusive ex-boyfriend who sought to control her life. For Jae, however, the trip represents a new chapter as she learns to stand on her own again. Her vacation takes an interesting turn when she’s mistakenly assigned to the same hotel room as Joff, a handsome and successful businessman who is intrigued by Jae’s kind and independent nature. Meanwhile, a sinister figure from Jae’s past begins to haunt her once again…

(Source: WEBTOONS)

146392.description:
After being accidentally electrocuted, Li Xiuxian transmigrated into the world of the game Martial Heroes to become the big boss of the Demon Cult's Xinchen Palace. His job is to fight off adventurers and occasionally sexually harass his subordinates. But even though he has great spiritual strength, he has no martial arts skill at all. Even worse, he knows from the plot of the game that the Demon Cult will get wiped out in two weeks. Now he is most worried about how to hang on and change his destiny!

(Source: Kuaikan, Translated)

146393.description:
U-Won is a pizza delivery guy down on his luck, and Seo-An is wealthy man suffering from panic attacks and social phobia. You wouldn’t think these two would have any reason to get to know one another, but one small kindness leads to a series of encounters that bring the two men closer together than either of them anticipated. Maybe they can find the solutions to their problems together…or perhaps they don’t need solutions, but simply each other.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

One day, a 30-year-old virgin man happened to find a pretty girl in a residential area. The unlucky daughter was Yoko, the second daughter of the Ogawa family. However, the runaway of the man who knew the pleasure of sexual intercourse for the first time did not stop, and he put on a choker with a bomb and confined Yoko. He finally threatened and began to involve her family! Her sister becomes her sister, and her mother becomes the prey of the man's carnal desire to help her daughters ... After journeying alongside her fiancé on his quest to defeat the Demon King, Romelia is suddenly deemed useless and sent home, her engagement annulled. While the prince and his group return as celebrated heroes, Rome goes home as a disgrace. But she’s not the same girl who left her province. While following the adventurers, Rome was the only one without magic or strength but she found her own abilities in trade, negotiation, finances, and gathering information. And now, she plans to use these skills to not only help her family’s province, but help the still struggling kingdom. The Demon King may be defeated, but his allies and demons continue to roam.

With only her wits and brilliance, Rome will build an army of her own and keep the kingdom safe—no matter what it takes.

In the future, countless alien beasts will invade across the universe. Humans that devour the alien flesh can absorb their genetic powers, which ushered in an era of rapid genetic evolution. Han Sen, a newcomer to the base, became known as the "butt fiend" and despised by others. But in secret, he's actually the overpowered "B God" admired by everyone! Ji Anruan lived in a monastery until she was five, when the nun who raised her took her from the monastery to meet her five dads. With her cuteness, she made a good impression on the first dad they met, Mu Shen. He thought he didn't like kids and he would never have kids of his own. But as Mu Shen spent more time with Ruan-Ruan, he found himself being won over by her and becoming the stereotypical doting father. But that was when Mu Shen found out that he's not the only one who would be Ruan-Ruan's guardian...

(Source: iQiyi, translated)

A midquel to Boys Over Flowers, taking place after chapter 177.

It follows Tsukushi Makino and Tsukasa Domyoji, during their early days of dating officially.

146408.description:
"I decided a long time ago that I would tell you once we turned 18."
"Marry me."

The day before high-school senior Nino turns 18, her handsome and extremely popular childhood friend, Ichi, proposes to her. Practically raised together as siblings, she can't believe his feelings and turns him down. He quickly counters with, "Let's do an experiment to see if we can be in a relationship or not"...?!

From then on, he hugs and dotes on Nino no matter where they are, and schemes on how to get her all to himself.

"Can you be mine and mine alone already?" But things aren't as simple as he hoped. When you're head over heels for your longest and closest friend, even the sweetest of love has a lot on the line!

Riho has an annoying habit in relationships that means they rarely last. Then she coincidentally meets up with her first love, Mamiya, who she went to middle school with. Riho is genuinely delighted at their reunion, but Mamiya seems to be acting a little strange... This is a (chaotic) romantic comedy about college students with some fairly difficult romantic habits! Can you sympathize with them or not?

146411.description:
Three years ago, Shen Yucheng and Mo Ran were framed into a night of entanglement but failed to remember each other’s face. Shen Yucheng was blackmailed with his photos. For his own benefits, he lied about her being his girlfriend who was going to study overseas for three years. Three years later—pressured with marriage—he found her figure to be very similar to the woman he had a one-night-stand with and signed a contract with her to be a contractual partner. Mo Ran was originally a rich lady, but she was cast out of her family because of a plot and had to resort to taking the roles of movie extras. How would the love life of the romantic CEO and middle-aged background actress develop from this?

(Source: Bilibli Comics)

In the Xuanjian Continent, swordsmanship is prized above all, powerful swordsman roamed the earth, and stories abound about legendary cultivators... Today, the continent's swordsmen weren't as glamorous as in the past, but sword cultivation was still widely practiced. One day, a cultivation prodigy accidentally triggered the Sword Forge System. The Sword Forge allowed him to access countless legendary swords of past and present. With his first legendary weapon in hand, the young man was on his way towards piercing a path to immortality...

What’s a girl to do when she has sworn off love completely? Get married, of course! When Seung-Hui Wu is scarred after the end of a relationship eight years ago, she refuses to even consider dating. But when her father comes to her with a old contract he made, promising her to another man’s son, there’s not much she can do. Despite her circumstances, Seung-Hui is determined to get married on her own terms, which are all conveniently laid out... in a prenup!

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Osumoji!: Tsukasa no Ikkan was serialized in Weekly Shounen Sunday until March 2013 (16th issue), and moved to the web magazine Club Sunday on April 5.

A world where magic exists.
The famous wizards known as “red and blue eyes” are considered nothing more than a legend after being assassinated for their special abilities. In modern times, they appear as heroes in movies and soap operas and thus become wildly popular.
The newly elected minister of magic announces his plan to destroy the magic ball that caused a disaster. Heera, who has been hiding her identity as “red and blue eyes” her whole life, joins in the effort to break up the magic ball for her sick daughter.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

146432.description:
A dizzyingly sweet urge he is feeling for the first time. Kentaro, a second-year high school boy, meets Mizuki, a popular senior on campus. One day, Kentaro sees Mizuki with a girl in the infirmary, Kentaro catches Mizuki afterwards and impulsively kisses him....... A possessive junior x a playboy senior!

Akito Terada is an ordinary salaryman, except that he has a special physical characteristic that made his injuries heal unusually quickly. His grandfather, a genetics researcher, conducts a thorough examination of Terada's body... blood, cells, and sperm, and finds that he not only healed quickly, but also had a gene that made him very fertile. Terada is traumatized by the thought that any woman would get pregnant if he had sex with her… Until a sperm bank learns of this and asks Terada to donate his sperm. Terada was suspicious of the request, which smelled so fishy, He accepts the request, but only under the absurd conditions that the recipient must be a woman under 30 years old and that the donation must be done via direct sexual intercourse. Later that day, such a request actually came in…

(Source: cmoa, translated)

Note: Includes “ Haramaseya 3.5”.

Hundreds of years have passed since a weather control satellite went haywire and started a war that destroyed the human race. After waking up from a long sleep, the android Laliberta met a clone girl named Speranza. Since Speranza could not live in the open air, the two interact with each other through a window... This is a series of stories depicting the thoughts and feelings of the girls surrounding the apocalypse.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

1. Saiteigi Suru Kibou (再定義する希望)
2. Tsugihagi no Kibou wo Idaite (継ぎ接ぎの希望を抱いて)
3. Tomoshibi no Kikaitachi (灯火の機械たち)

Gu Ning tried to stop a murder she foresaw but the victim did not heed her advice. Hence, she rushed to lodge a police report. However, she ended up being suspected by the police because she reported the case before it happened. Captain Zhan Ming began to pay attention to the strange woman. Even though Zhan Ming did not believe in her so-called death predictions, Gu Ning repeatedly surprised him. By staring into the eyes of the dead, Gu Ning would know details that only the medical examiner should have known. She could even draw the scene of the crime with an ink brush on the spot. By sitting on a chair from the crime scene, she would be able to see the crime unfold from the other side...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Winter has arrived in the Kingdom of Highland, and Anne Halford, aspiring Silver Sugar Master, is struggling to make ends meet. Barely scraping by with her earnings, Anne is worrying about securing lodging for the upcoming holidays when she hears exciting news. The Duke of Philax will award an extraordinary amount of money to whoever makes the best sugar candy according to his wishes! Anne immediately jumps at the opportunity but finds herself competing against Jonas. The Duke is notoriously difficult to please—who will win his approval first?

The Royal Candy Fair approaches, and Anne Halford is ready to tackle the competition again to win the title of Silver Sugar Master! However, she is in a bind due to the year’s poor harvest of sugar apples—the most important ingredient for silver sugar—and the only way to obtain the limited few is by working at the Radcliffe Workshop. Despite having had terrible encounters with the candy crafters from that faction, Anne decides to go, as she won’t let anything deter her from achieving her dream. Now she just needs to find a motif for her sugar candy sculpture...

Once upon a time, a fearsome demon king died at the hands of brave heroes, returning peace throughout the world. One of the heroes who slew the demon king continues on his quest to protect humanity, but what happens when a demon child gets attached to him?

(Source: Manga Planet)

Anne has finally attained the title of Silver Sugar Master, but not without paying a price—Challe has sold his freedom to Bridget Paige, the daughter of the Paige Workshop maestro. Determined to get him back, Anne travels to the Paige Workshop and learns they’ll return him if she agrees to work for them. But then she’s assigned the difficult task of reviving the debt-ridden business, which is close to shutting down! Set on rescuing Challe, Anne doesn’t shy away from the challenge, but with only five candy crafters, and their faction’s long history of set traditions restricting her actions, how will she save the Paige Workshop…?

(Source: Yen Press)

To survive in the cruel Primordial Times, Li Changshou tried his best not to get involved in any conflicts and never allowing himself to walk into dangerous situations. As her vision fades, she catches glimpses of memories that she has never experienced being planted in her mind.

146563.description:
Saburou Oonishi, an ordinary boy known as Sabutan, is a member of the Anpaka Gang made up of naughty boys in the neighborhood. Sabutan is nearly forced to become the leader of the Anpaka Gang, but refuses. As punishment, he is made to walk through a dark underpass, still under construction, alone. The underpass is a place where mysterious phenomena are said to happen from time to time. Sabutan is absorbed into the wall where some tiles have come off, and strays into a four-dimensional world. There he finds a mysterious spacious room and a four-dimensional creature that looks something like a doll. Having been given the power to stop time by the four-dimensional creature, Sabutan comes back to this world. Now, by simply shouting "Time, be still!" everything freezes except Sabutan himself. In this way he can escape from bullets or train accidents. Because of this power, Sabutan begins to become entwined in mysterious events.

(Source: Tezuka Osamu Official)

No matter what he sets out to do, he always ended up as the number-one at it, but then he'd drop dead afterwards. So in this life Xu Xiaowen wished to live this life as an ordinary, useless guy, and survive until 80! But then the gods made a joke out of it, by making him an omnipotent being!?
