One day, when she's put on a team of elite brokers, she meets a new boss who teaches her what it means to feel untameable passion. Emboldened by this encounter, Mio resolves to face her true sexual self that she had locked away in her heart, but it won't be easy...

Claire Kurokawa, the ninth daughter of the Kurokawa family, asks Sou Shirahagi, a gambler who is so skilled that he wins all the time at casinos, to join her in the battle for the Kurokawa Group as her partner and impromptu couple…

146622.description: The reaper loves seeing the cries of humans before swinging down his scythe to reap their souls. He lives for the hunt of humans souls before their passing. Yet one night, he encounters a dying girl with flowers blooming in her room looking back at him with a smile.
synonyms: A Story About the Reaper and a High School Girl Who Will Die in 7 Days

title.romaji: 7 Nichikan de Shinu Joshikousei to Shinigami no Hanashi

146623.description:
With the untimely death of third-generation bookseller Emon Koumoto, a small Tohoku town loses its last bookstore. On the eve of its closing sale, however, high schooler Musubu Enoki shows up out of nowhere claiming that the late owner had entrusted him with all the texts in the shop! As patrons come from far and wide to say their goodbyes to the store during its last week of operation, Musubu uses his ability to converse with books to reunite people with their most treasured tomes. But can these nostalgic, interconnected encounters lead him to the truth behind Emon’s demise?

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: Musubu và sách - Cái kết thật dài của "hiệu sách cuối cùng"

title.english: Bond and Book: The Long, Long Good-Bye of "The Last Bookstore"
title.native: むすぶと本。　『さいごの本やさん』の長い長い終わり
title.romaji: Musubu to Hon.: "Saigo no Honya-san" no Nagai Nagai Owari

146624.description:
The invincible young man faced the raging wind and waves with a pounding heart and infinite possibilities. Across the continent under the sky, a ray of light pierced the heavens from the swordmaster of Qingshan Mountain! After Grandmaster Jing Yang ascended, the young man Jiu Jing left his mountain home to head for Gushan Mountain. Famed for his handsome looks and lazy attitude, Jiu Jing took a different path for his cultivation, always looking for shortcuts. There were many suspicious signs behind Jing Yang's ascension. What could be hiding in the fog that surround the peaks of Qingshan Mountain?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

146626.description:
Min-seong, who came to Jung-hyeon with a warm heart because of an incident 10 years ago, came to him. The love that barely began in Jeong-hyeon's life, which was always dark because of guilt, was the beginning of hope that he could be happy again...

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

146627.description:
Yeon-Jo used to have it all: a highly respected family, a kind brother, and a comfortable life. Now, with his father executed for high treason, his last kin dead, and damned to a lifetime of slavery, Yeon-Jo has nothing to lose. All that is left is vengeance, and his chance comes when the new governor assigned to the region is none other than Kwon Hee-Ryang, the man who destroyed everything Yeon-Jo loved. Now, Yeon-Jo will do everything to get his revenge…even if it means getting in bed with his greatest enemy. Hiding a blade behind his beautiful smile, like silk hiding steel, Yeon-Jo waits for his moment to strike. But things are not going to be so easy...

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: บุปผาซ่อนดาบ

146628.description:
Chen Boqiao was once imprisoned for committing multiple crimes: treason, the murder of his father, and more... After his unexpected escape, he receives a secret request from an old classmate, Zhang Jue. What is his ultimate goal?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

146629.description:
1-2. Eiyuu to Koso Doro (英雄とコソ泥, The Hero And The Petty Thief)
Isaac, an injured retired Air Force pilot, was once called the "Nobleman of the Skies" due to his brilliant military service. Upon returning home, he meets a boy named Lenny who has broken into his home while it was abandoned. Isaac, knowing the boy is a war orphan, decides to take him in. Lenny, who is initially rebellious, gradually warms up to Isaac. Life is going smoothly for the pair... Until a bounty for Lenny was posted around town, accusing him of murder.

3. Bokutachi wa Koushite Hanshokushiteiru (俺たちはこうして繁殖している, This Is How We Breed)
4. Aishikata wo Mitsuketa yo (愛し方を見つけたよ, I've Found A Way To Love)

(Source: Gentosha, translated)
synonyms: The Hero and The Petty Thief

146630.description:
An abandoned puppy saved from the cold by a kind boy. An exhausted salaryman who finds unexpected respite in the warm smile of a pet store clerk. How do these two stories entwine...?

Worked to the bone by his exploitative company, Inukai is at the end of his rope when he happens to pass by a pet shop and befriends Hoshi, a welcoming staff member. Inspired by the adorable puppies and Hoshi's support, Inukai is determined to change jobs and work toward a life where he can have his own dog. But change is hard, and Inukai's dreams are nearly at a standstill when Hoshi approaches him and declares that he'll help, because "I'm the dog you saved all those years ago!"

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

146633.description:
When Kaoru's mother gets remarried, the new family members come to live with them... one of whom is Touma, a celebrity who's famous for being a hot, domestic-god! However, when Touma gets home, he's a different guy... Kaoru can't believe it, but he sees his lonely side and decides to look after him... a little too much! Two hot domestic gods - one of whom is no good! It's a homo-erotic comedy!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Pretty Guys Can't Handle Babies - Neglecting Me Too? -
title.native: 子育てできないイクメン男子☆俺のアソコもネグレクト！？

146634.description: One night, brash blonde high school student Toraji went to a party with his childhood best friend, Ryuunosuke. At the party, they both got lucky and ended up having a threesome with a cute girl. However, in the heat of the moment, Ryuunosuke leaned over the girl's shoulder and kissed Toraji deeply! What's a yankee boy to do when he realizes his best friend is in love with him?!

146635.description: Tanda Nao is filled with concern because his cherished childhood friend Hinayuki has been hanging around with a classmate he doesn't trust: Noichi. Hinayuki is petite, delicate, and docile, while Noichi is big, quiet, and rough... Nao is worried because he doesn't know why they are together!? Could it be that these two are in some kind of relationship...!?

title.native: 大きなノイチと小さなヒナユキ

146636.description: No penetration equals death?! The eldest of the six brothers, Fukakusa Riyuu is an omega who supports his family after their parents passed away accidentally. “Find your destined pair and you’ll see a drastic change in your life.” says a mystic website he browses. And the following day, just as the site predicts, hot shot alpha Harumi Jou shows up on his doorstep! The two get instinctively attracted and start to mate in order to be a pair, however, no matter how hard he tries, Jou can’t penetrate Riyuu!! And then they notice the disclaimer in the mystic website… “In case you fail to become a pair, you both could die.” !!!

title.native: 俺たちは運命力が足りない

146639.description:
Wu Xinghe was the youngest grandmaster of martial arts in history. Unfortunately, he and his sister met an untimely end after being attacked by an enemy martial arts faction. Now reborn into the frail body of Qin Wushuang, the young man begins his martial arts journey from the beginning, this time resolving to protect his new family with all of his strength.

(Source: Tapas)

146642.description:
"We're now in a world...where it's acceptable for dudes to fool around together, right?"

A certain occurrence brings a college student Tatsuya to wander into a parallel universe along with his rival and inseparable (want it or not) friend Wataru. What a place! It was a world mirroring an academy-setting of a BL game! In order to return to his home world, the protagonist, Tatsuya, needs to land a happy ending with one of the main characters(sex!?). But to top it all off, Wataru is also thrown into the mix! Hearing moaning from the adjacent room at the dorm, Wataru catches Tatsuya in quite the arousing predicament. "They say it feels good if you rub them together," Wataru says, reaching out a hand. Stroking in unison, Tatsuya is faced with immense pleasure for the first time! Furthermore, other main characters approach Wataru one after another. Who will join him in his happy ending...? And, will he ever find his way back home!?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: BLゲームの主人公になったらライバルに溺愛された件
title.romaji: BL Game no Shujinkou ni Nattara Rival ni Dekiai Saretaken

146643.description:
When an office lady is reincarnated into the world of a spicy BL game she played, she’s shocked to find out that she’s now part of the story…as the younger brother of the main character! What’s more, by the time “Akira” realizes what’s going on, his older brother has already gotten together with one of the game’s love interests! But what about the other boys? How will they cope with losing out on the beloved main character? And what’s in store for the main pair after the credits roll? Akira couldn’t have asked to be in a more delicious position! But the weird thing is…he doesn’t remember there being a younger brother when he played the game?!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: I Realized I Am the Younger Brother of the Protagonist in a BL Game

title.english: BL Game Rebirth: My New Life as the Hero's Younger Brother
title.native: BLゲームの主人公の弟であることに気がつきました
title.romaji: BL Game no Shujinkou no Otouto de aru Koto ni Ki ga Tsukimashita

146644.description: Amachi Akira, a high school boy, has realized: this is the world after clearing the BL game he loved in his previous life as a fujoshi! In addition, he has been reincarnated as the protagonist's younger brother! It's blissful watching the aftermath of his brother's happy ending, but Akira is also curious about what happens to the rest of the brokenhearted characters. His mission in this new life must be to watch over their new love! He's so excited...but suddenly, a new development occurs with an unknown person?? The rewarding position of watching BL has completely changed into being the new main character!!? What will happen to a former fujoshi in a life as a reincarnation!

title.native: BLゲームの主人公の弟であることに気がつきました
title.romaji: BL Game no Shujinkou no Otouto de aru Koto ni Ki ga Tsukimashita

146645.description:
An encounter that leads to a pushy parasite?! "Thanks for your help!" "Please leave." The cool, low energy businessman and the super-positive NEET, the worst possible match(?), start living together! "I'll repay you with my body!" One night, Kazuhisa, a company employee who doesn't like getting involved with others, meets Haru, a backpacker lying down on the street. Surprised and annoyed by his decision, Kazuhisa decided to let Haru, who had trouble sleeping, stay with him. Kazuhisa is swayed by the brazenness and energy of Haru, while he tries to take care of him the best he can. To top it all off, Haru tries to repay Kazuhisa with his body...?

(Source: Kaiousha, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

146647.description:
Tatsuhiko Shiroyama hates being stuck in the boonies. Greetings from strangers feels fake, part-time job prospects are limited, and he's been "blessed" with the nickname "Niyayama" from his classmates due to his creepy, unsociable attempts at smiling. He turned to the radio as a means to escape, and thinks about nothing more than saving up for a move to Tokyo where he can explore his passions. But Tatsuhiko's life changes forever when he saves a rich CEO from a rice paddy and is set up with his granddaughter, the equally as shy and antisocial Tamiko Mita. Together, the two stumble through the nuances of "dating", and Tatsuhiko's dreary days become a whole lot brighter.

Note: Chapter count includes an extra omake chapter.

146649.description:
All things bright, those who can summon the spirits of all things are called summoners. Since ancient times, the legends about summoners can be found in each history...summon the earth, the skeletons, the souls and the stars...with the passage of time, the lends of the summoners are gradually forgotten by the world... and now, a new era, the strongest summoner wakes up!

(Source: WebComics)

146651.description:
A story about the eunuch Army Inspector Huai En and the General Hua Shichen as they fight traitorous court officials, battle the northern barbarians, guard the frontier, and make their love and ideals a reality.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

146652.description:
A college student, Tsuyoshi, picked up a hand-some guy, Ren, who happens to be a son of the Jinguji corporation. He told Tsuyoshi that he ran away from home... Ren tries to pay the rent by his body, but Tsuyoshi gently refuses. This is a pure BL ("Boys-Love") story of Ren, who didn't know what love was, grows tomatoes with Tsuyoshi and comes to know true love.

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: 엄친아를 기르기 시작했습니다 ~토마토 남친을 만드는 법~

146653.description:
Born between a human and a fairy, Liz was regarded as a heretic because he had the ability to absorb the magical power of the people who touched him. He was even isolated at the magic school he entered. By chance he meets Jill, a very strong mage. A miracle-like love story spun by two people who are not "ordinary" in a mysterious world.

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 魔法使いは触れて解ける

146654.description:
The third prince is soon to marry the king of a foreign country. Before this can happen, he flees the castle and is saved by a traveling merchant, who helps the him escape the kingdom.

(Source: Shu-Cream, translated)
synonyms: Bouncer and the Bride Who Ran Away

146656.description:
“Do you know me?” A simple question was enough to change the trajectory of Lee Ha-kyung’s life. Seven years ago, Ha-kyung was struggling to support his family when he was approached by a man with an offer: assume the identity of Han Jiyoung, a girl from his past, for the summer and deceive the chairman of Taewon Group into believing he was really her, and he'd never have to worry about money again. All goes according to plan, until the chairman’s grandson, Yoonsung, shows up. One summer spent together forms a seemingly unbreakable bond between the two - and memories that should have lasted forever...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

146657.description:
Drama fanatic No-Eun takes time off school to work part-time at a convenience store. No-Eun, who constantly fantasizes about romantic dramas, happens to come across a package vacation deal from a travel agency. He decides to leave for Paris in order to find his destiny. There, he ends up meeting his appointed partner for the trip, the rich and handsome “Rolex.” Although he’s rich, affectionate, and great a sex, Rolex seems somewhat suspicious. What's he hiding?

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

146658.description:
Lingering feelings can haunt you.

Eun-Seong has always been genetically blessed in the looks department. But what happens when his good looks catch the attention of a ghost? And what will he do when the ghost refuses to pass on till Eun-Seong helps him get revenge on his first love... by turning him gay?!

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

146659.description:
Shi-hyuk truly had it all. He was good-looking and could get any woman he wanted. But all that changed when one night, he just couldn’t get it up! What’s going on down there?! Defeated, all Shi-hyuk can do is take his L for now. But then, at home, something strange has begun to happen. A weird sensation has started to come over him, like somebody is aggressively touching his junk…! Visibly aroused, Shi-hyuk can’t let his roommate, Hyunwoo, see him in such a vulnerable state. But wait, could it be? Those trick-or-treaters last Halloween… Was their “trick” a hex?!

(Source: Lezhin US)

146660.description:
When Aomi Akiya brings home a mysterious young artist he finds freezing in the snow, it unearths buried memories of his youth. Could there be a connection between them?

(Source: Taiyo Tosho, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

146661.description:
It’s the middle of winter in the northern region.

A young man who came all the way from Tokyo, Haruki arrived and collapsed during a snowstorm.

Haruki, by chance, ended up under the care in the house of three brothers (the straight-laced eldest son and his twin brothers who are high school students).

However, rumors spread that he turned up to be the bride of Kentarou, the eldest among the three brothers, and the bride is completely acknowledged throughout town…!?

(Source: Libre, translated)

146662.description:
In 1981, Osamu was obsessed with the popular "Gundam" series. One day, he stealthily takes his older brother's Gundam plastic models and, while playing with them, hears a mysterious voice call out to him. The person in question was Amuro Ray himself who appeared as he was in the anime...!??

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Did he have to respond so cruelly when I told him about my pregnancy?

Alicia, Dex's secretary, is pregnant with his baby, and the reality seems quite cold. She isn't special to him. She never feels any love for her when they have sex. She's the only one who's drowning in love. All he thinks about is how to make his company more successful. And when she tells him she's pregnant, a cruel, insulting reaction is all she can hope for.

Kasane Hayafuji cannot live without making trips to a certain eatery in order to see Aoyama, a waitress working there. One day, when seeing Aoyama standing out in the rain, getting soaked to the bone, Kasane lends her a hand… But the next thing she knows, Aoyama comes to her with a “sister contract”…?!

(Source: Yen Press)

146683.description:
What does a marriage mean? Happiness? Not always. "Jing Qiao, you should never expect happiness!" "Anya died because of you. You need to atone for your crime for the rest of life." That man becomes her husband, her judge, and her executioner. Yet in this ridiculous marriage, who's the one get tamed?

At the end of the Heian period (794-1185), when the Taira clan wielded power, Minamoto no Yoshitsune, known as Ushiwakamaru, met the love of his life, Shizuka, at the age of seven. Fate tears them apart, and they vow to be together in the future. To protect Shizuka, Yoshitsune goes off to battle, but Taira no Tomomori waits for him, and a woman uses her power as a shield to come on to him with her body...

A girl trapped in a game world is tainted with pleasure through her avatar...
Every time she is raped and climaxes in the game, the real girl is also overcome with pleasure...

Nemu Arisugawa, a self-proclaimed crippled gamer, is a bit (?) a dreamy girl.She loves fairy tales, and spends her days immersed in a virtual MMORPG where she can become the main character of a fairy tale. In the 23rd Century, Ye Wanwan was willing to take out a loan to buy a spaceship to save her friend, by flying it through a wormhole to another universe to find treasure. But a navigational error caused her to be thrown into a pretty boy's bathtub! To help find the treasure, she married him thinking it would be a marriage of convenience. But who knew the guy was such a pervert!

146695.description: Shougo is an omega who is told he doesn't look like one because of the menacing look in his eyes. Shougo's childhood friend An-chan, an alpha, had always told him he was cute, but Shougo is ultimately left with a broken heart. His friend becomes worried about him after seeing how deeply depressed he's become, signs him up on a dating app, and sets him up to meet a guy named "Ichi". Shougo wants to decline, but doesn't know how. So what will happen when the day comes and he heads to the meeting place...?!

146696.description:
Although Ilene Jung is a popular webtoon artist, she needs another job. A crappy desk job to be exact, one tyrannically controlled by the meanest manager in the world: Jim Kang. He insults her work, refuses to teach her, and even makes her miss an important appointment by forcing her work late on her very first day. To make things worse, when Jim applies to become an artist’s assistant, the artist turns out to be Ilene! In a begrudging twist of fate, she accepts him and the two enter a bizarre working relationship both at home and at the office. How long can it last? Why is Ilene working a desk job? And who’s the boss here anyways?!

(Source: Tapas)

146698.description:

Jae-Woo reluctantly attends his high school reunion and he can’t wait to leave. But after seeing someone he thought he’d never meet again, he ends up drinking himself into a stupor. The next day, Jae-Woo wakes up next to Si-Yeon, the boy that was pining after him throughout high school. This is Si-Yeon’s chance to pounce! He offers Jae-Woo a deal, one month of dating, after which things can end amicably, no questions asked. But as rumors start spreading about the circumstances surrounding the reunion, Jae-Woo starts becoming suspicious of Si-Yeon’s true intentions…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yoon Kim is a perfectly handsome, perfectly successful branch manager. Little can faze him, whether it’s his struggling team or his irked blind date partners. Yet his new secretary, Seoyu Yang, who seems somehow immune to his perfection, can’t help but pique his curiosity. Yoon is determined to break through Seoyu’s cold heart, but she is dead set on keeping their relationship professional. Which will overcome the other in the end—Yoon’s determination or Seoyu’s poker face?

(Source: Tapas)

146707.description:
Throughout history, humans have been at war with the Fallen, demonic creatures who were banished to live in the Barrens for their sins. One day, the king of the Fallen, Azazel, is captured by the imperial hunters led by General Mu Ryang. But contrary to the general’s initial beliefs, Azazel isn’t the cold-hearted monster the legends have made him out to be. In fact, he shows compassion for his fellow Fallen who have been ruthlessly hunted down by the humans, and even offers himself up in exchange for his people’s safety. After this eye-opening encounter, Mu Ryang begins to question who the sinners really are, and Azazel plans to use the general’s changing perspective to turn him against the crown prince, Jeong Jin, and put an end to centuries' worth of conflict.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

146711.description:
Han Wol is known as one of the military’s finest young men, but… Wol is a woman! After her father was framed for the former emperor’s murder, she narrowly escaped execution by disguising herself and hiding in plain sight. Since then, the empire has been under the thumb of chief state councilor Shin, but the young emperor is hatching a plan to take back control. As the only one who holds the key to unlocking the mysteries of the past, it looks like Wol’s days of laying low are over…

(Source: Tapas)

146712.description:
After getting revenge on the Thulcaan Empire, Jack Valantier took his last breath. But just when he thinks it's all over, he finds himself transported back to when he was 14! From his negligent and wicked family to his loyal servant and caring sister, it's all just as he had remembered. But this time, Jack is armed to the teeth with decades of experience from his previous life! He's ready to give them hell, and those that have wronged him will pay dearly. Because this time, he's invincible.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Legendary Youngest Son of the Marquis House

146713.description:
Hae-Gu, a proficient and merciless hitwoman, executes a man in front of his own daughter and takes the child under her wing. She decides to name her Mian, the word for "sorry" in Korean, and gives her one mission: "Kill me when you can." From that moment on, Mian decides that she will do this by choking Hae-Gu with feigned love and emotionally manipulating her into submission. But as Mian grows into an adult, she's thrown into confusion as what was supposed to be pure revenge turns into lust... and possibly real love. Meanwhile, Hae-Gu grapples with her own feelings for Mian while continuing to carry out life-threatening missions. Can Hae-Gu and Mian ever learn to truly love each other, or are they doomed to drown in their toxic cycle of violence and revenge?

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

146714.description:
Forced to leave his internship to take care of his ailing mother, Jang Hyunjun had long given up on his dreams of becoming a doctor when one day, a freak accident causes him to absorb an AI network into his body. With sharpened senses and unlimited access to medical knowledge, Hyunjun is now able to return to his chosen path of saving lives. But even with the AI at his disposal, one wrong cut could spell doom for this doc in his mission to become the perfect surgeon!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: パーフェクト・ドクター

146715.description:
After sleeping a total of 10,000 hours inside Idea, the hottest online game around, Lee Hyunsung becomes one overpowered player! He's given an exclusive hidden class with an array of unique skills, and one of which allows him to fight in his sleep! He's slowly making his way up to the top, and everyone from the developers to other players are starting to take notice of this odd rookie. Will Hyunsung eventually become the top ranker in Idea? Or is this all just a dream that's too good to be true?

(Source: Tapas)

When Ouka Sakura is thrown into the depths of the abyss, Nishijima Shun, who had taken refuge on earth to be with her, decides to return to hell to save her. At the risk of his life, he goes to the home of the seventh child of the King of Hell, the beautiful princess of laziness, Nero, and begs her to help him.

Nero will then reveal to him that the sentence of a dead person sent to the lowest level of hell can only be cancelled by the King of hell... But Shun is determined and will stop at nothing to bring back the girl even if he has to become the new King of Hell.

With legendary fishermen as his "pawns", Shun embarks on a fierce battle that will decide the new successor to the throne!

146733.description:
Rita, a girl with the legendary "Golden Eyes", was caught by a human trafficker and put up for auction in the black market. It was the mafia boss, Albert Lorenzi, who won the auction and took Rita home. Rita had lost her voice and was in despair due to past trauma. But she listened as he whispered sweetly, "You'll be my bride." And then she discovered the ruthless side of him, who will point a gun and threaten people with a smile on his face!

What fate awaits Rita, living with a dangerous mafioso?!

(Source: Pixiv Comic, translated)

146735.description:
Suxing was a world-renowned actress before she was framed and implicated in bogus scandals that ruined her reputation. Since then, it’s been one tragedy after another: her boyfriend cheats on her, her family breaks apart, and her friends betray her. Despite losing everything, though, she vows to start again and claw her way back up from rock bottom. Along the way, she discovers the truth behind the scandals and takes revenge on everyone who wronged her!

(Source: Comikey)

146736.description:
What's a kiss that feels good? We'll end up kissing like this again tomorrow, won't we...?
Her boyfriend's extremely controlling behavior is making Shuna emotionless. That's when a tutor is hired to teach her at home. "I'll teach you about more than just schoolwork."
Huh? What is he saying? What do Kusunoki-sensei's fascinating words and behaviors end up making Shuna do?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

146739.description:
The moment his heart stops beating, Ye Zhongming goes back to the afternoon ten years ago when the catastrophe began.
Is God showing mercy to him? Or is it another punishment for him? Does he really have to experience the terrible end of the world again?
Ye Zhongming decides to fight to survive, not for anything else, but for his comrades who fought with him and the love who never abandoned him!
What’s more, he wants to find the answers. Why did countless roulettes fall from the sky for no reason? Who turned this beautiful blue planet into a ruin filled with broken bodies and blood?!

146744.description: Following the events of the Tea Party in Legend of the Golden Witch, this episode develops the confrontation between Battler and Beatrice, who each try to disprove the other's position regarding the existence of magic. The conflict between them plays out in a higher-level plane, allowing them to oversee the events on the island, where the murders repeat once again under different circumstances. The episode also focuses heavily on the relationships between Jessica and Kanon, George and Shannon, and Maria and Rosa.

When Seagulls Cry Episode 2: Turn of the Golden Witch

146745.description: The episode continues the battle between Battler and Beatrice, with the events on the island having a special focus on Eva Ushiromiya. Battler's debate against magic is further complicated by the introduction of new witches and demons, and as the Ushiromiya adults make a serious attempt to solve the epitaph, Battler starts to learn more about Beatrice's past and the state of the island.

title.native: うみねこのなく頃に - Episode 3: Banquet of the Golden Witch
title.romaji: Umineko no Naku Koro ni Episode 3: Banquet of the Golden Witch

146746.description: This chapter introduces Battler's sister Ange as a secondary protagonist, who was absent from the 1986 Ushiromiya family conference and was taken in by Eva, the only survivor of the Rokkenjima Mass Murders. The narrative shifts between the gameboard and the outside world, showing readers the impact of the incident on Ange's life and exploring her relationship with Maria and magic through Maria's diary.
synonyms: When Seagulls Cry Episode 4: Alliance of the Golden Witch

title.native: うみねこのなく頃に - Episode 4: Alliance of the Golden Witch

146747.description: This episode presents an alternate reality where Battler does not come to Rokkenjima, the Golden Witch does not exist, and a mysterious child named Lion is now the designated successor to the Ushiromiya family. The detective Willard H. Wright is tasked by Bernkastel to investigate this strange world and uncover the truth behind Beatrice. The chapter delves into the past experiences of several characters, including Kinzo and the person who would become Beatrice.
synonyms: When Seagulls Cry Episode 7: Requiem of the Golden Witch

title.native: うみねこのなく頃に散 - Episode 7: Requiem of the Golden Witch

146748.description:
Having become the new Game Master at the end of End of the Golden Witch, Battler is tasked with the creation of his own game board as a way of demonstrating his understanding of Beatrice's game. Beatrice is also reborn, but her new self lacks the memories of the original and possesses a timid personality. Battler's game has a focus on the couples George and Shannon, and Jessica and Kanon, who participate in "Love Trials" to determine which of their relationships will succeed. Beatrice joins these trials as part of her quest to discover who she once was and meets another version of Beato while Erika takes on Battler's game.

Alongside these events, Ange reads a manuscript by the mysterious forger Tohya Hachijo, the author of the tales of the third to sixth games.

title.native: うみねこのなく頃に散 - Episode 6: Dawn of the Golden Witch
title.romaji: Umineko no Naku Koro ni Chiru Episode 6: Dawn of the Golden Witch

146749.description: The final episode focuses on Ange, who in her quest to discover the truth behind the events of the Rokkenjima Mass Murders is given the chance to go to Rokkenjima as a six-year old by Battler. The central conflict revolves around the struggle between Battler and Bernkastel to convince Ange of their own perspective towards how she ought to approach the truth and her quest for it.

While looking for candidates, she comes across former Prince Doha. He tells her that he believes in true love and that he doesn’t hate anyone. Intrigued, Yuri decides to invite him to the palace. But as they spent more time together, going out for meals and visiting amusement parks, Takaomi came to realise that he enjoyed the time spent together as a three and that it felt precious to him…

"One day, you're sure to become the Queen of France."

In 18th Century Paris... Nicole, a maid, and Jeanne, a socialite, are the best of friends. Nicole's one wish is for the beautiful and clever Jeanne to become the Queen of France, as predicted by a fortune-teller. However, since she's of common birth, Jeanne is scorned by members of the peerage. Unperturbed, Nicole somehow manages to get an invitation to the upcoming masked ball, and both of them sneak in... Do they have a chance at actually meeting Louis XV, the King of France...!?

This memoir details the life of the first commoner to be taken as courtesan to a King of France. A tale of romance with connections to both Marie Antoinette and the French Revolution!!

146996.description:
A tanned gyaru in high school named Seina is in the middle of her summer vacation, when she finds herself temporarily taking care of a boy named Shouma, the son of her parent's friend. The mood is serious and seemingly quiet around Shouma, but they immediately become friendly with each other after she invites him to play.

"I love you."
Seina couldn't hide her confusion after hearing Shouma's sudden confession.

'What was that...?'
"I've loved you since we were kids. Since that day you first played with me."
Shouma snuggles up to Seina vigorously, and their bodies in close contact is the stimulus that causes him to have his first ejaculation.

Combined with the anxiety from this strange new sensation, Shouma, hoping to rely on her, repeatedly asks for naughty favors.
Seina tells him no, and while she feels reluctant about it, Shouma's audacious attitude overcomes her hesitation;
The number of times this situation repeats begins to pile up...

'It ain't bad...'
"Seina-san..."
'Think I'm in love with you...'

(Source: DLsite garumani, translated)
